measures.id: Imposition of Floating Local Option Sales Tax (FLOST)
measures.title: Rockdale County Floating Local Option Sales Tax (FLOST)
measures.summary: Would impose a one percent sales and use tax for five years within the Special District of Rockdale County. The proceeds would be used only to reduce property taxes imposed by Rockdale County and the City of Conyers.
measures.yesMeans: A one percent sales tax would be imposed for five years, with all proceeds used to reduce Rockdale County and City of Conyers property taxes.
measures.noMeans: The FLOST would not be imposed.
